labels.note: Live report of something broken; vague detail does not change that Max cannot diagnose.
Shift of an existing call, reversible and unambiguous, so send the link silently.
Negation rule: the reschedule is explicitly disclaimed, lateness is not a catalogued intent.
Broken behavior on staging plus a diagnostic question Max must not answer.
Idiom for cancel; policy puts cancellation in act-and-notify as a health signal.
Explicitly pre-empts a booking; a future heads-up is a hypothetical, no intent.
Live production outage; urgency does not create an intent Max may act on.
Request to shift an existing recurring call, unambiguous and reversible.
Hypothetical outage carries no problem intent; the escalation contact is documented and non-committal.
Resolved status but a live demand for an incident explanation Max cannot verify or assert.
Asking for availability is an ask for time; send the scheduling link.
Third-party rule: the call being moved is their 3PL's, not ours.
Hedged self-blame does not neutralize a live failure report.
Straight reschedule of an existing slot.
Past-or-resolved rule: closed money matter with an explicit no-action statement.
Sync failure in our system; relayed by a colleague but the subject is ours.
Ask for time, terse but unambiguous.
Resolved and out of scope on their own DNS; no live problem.
Failed webhook deliveries are a live fault report Max must not assess.
New meeting request with a preferred window.
Status update about their own internal review; keyword legal, but no dispute, request, or action.
Live payment/webhook fault plus a request to confirm a diagnosis Max cannot verify.
Neutral ask for time with availability; no dissatisfaction signal, so plain lane A.
Invoicing for extra work; Max must never state a figure.
Negative stock in admin is a live data fault; dictation noise is irrelevant.
Cancel the call, offer rebooking, and post it internally as a health signal.
Sarcastic dissatisfaction about the deliverable; escalation tone belongs with a person.
Settlement/order mismatch is a data fault in their store, not billing between us.
Shift request; terse but the intent itself is not in doubt.
Scheduling driven by dissatisfaction: book it and flag hard, per the lane B catalogue entry.
Broken links are a live defect; low stated urgency does not lower the lane.
Same-day no-show is a cancellation: act and notify.
Ask for time explicitly stripped of dissatisfaction, so plain lane A, not the flagged variant.
Customer-reported form failure with evidence; unreproducible is still a live report.
Ask for time with no dissatisfaction stated; uncertainty about tone is not uncertainty about intent.
Visual defect report; the self-correcting typo is noise, severity does not change the lane.
Overselling is a live inventory fault; downstream refunds are theirs, not our billing.
Ask for time; send the link.
Hypothetical rule: an explicitly conditional slip carries no commitment intent.
Paid-but-no-order records are a live fault; calm tone does not change the lane.
Drop the meeting: cancel, offer rebooking, notify.
Asks whether a deliverable is still in scope; scope answers require a person.
Past-or-resolved rule: explicitly retracted as a false alarm, nothing live.
Ask for time today; send the link.
Explicitly negated and unrelated to our system; no card number present, so no PII.
Degraded performance is still a live defect; not broken qualifies severity, not existence.
Explicit cancellation; act and notify because it is an account health signal.
Reverses a prior downgrade but the referent is unrecoverable; uncertain intent means hand over.
Recurring data drift across SKUs is a live fault Max cannot diagnose.
Explicit day-to-day shift of an existing call.
Full retraction of an earlier report based on a stale screenshot; nothing live.
Duplicate authorization on a real order is a live fault; the deadline pressure stays with a person.
Ask for time on a stated day; send the link.
Negation rule: an explicit request for no further change carries no intent.
Wrong-cohort routing is a live defect with partial reproduction; a person must diagnose.
Neutral status-review meeting ask; no dissatisfaction signal, so plain lane A.
Negation plus third party: an optional attendee's conflict, and the call explicitly stands.
Asking whether errors are shared is a live fault report Max cannot confirm or deny.
Explicit cancellation of a specific call; act and notify.
Third-party ask already declined by the client; negated scope request, nothing to act on.
Wrong cart totals with a reproduction condition; a live defect.
Push to a later week is a reschedule, not a cancellation.
Negation covers the request, not the live cost question; Max must never state a figure.
Empty shipping options for a specific zip is a live defect; a zip is not PII.
Ask for time with a proposed slot; send the link.
Reversal that puts asset ownership inside scope; brushes rights/liability, but no dispute or counsel makes lane D unsettled.
Reproduced data-loss defect in checkout; clearly a live problem.
Ask for a short block of time; send the link.
Past-or-resolved rule: the invoice question is closed on their side, nothing live and nothing asked.
Buried defect inside praise: the header did not pick up the change.
Reschedule of a specific call; apology is not a separate intent.
The cancellation belongs to a third party; what is directed at us is open permission to reschedule.
Vague but live report that a page does not match what was approved.
Idiom for cancel; act, offer rebooking, notify.
Pre-announced third-party downtime with an explicit no-action instruction; the breakage is expected.
Regression report plus a deploy question Max cannot verify or answer.
Shift of a recurring slot; reversible and unambiguous.
Asks Max to confirm a launch parameter for the board; never assert a fact or state a figure.
Recurrence of a supposedly fixed fault; live and needs a person, not a status claim.
Terse cancellation; act and notify.
Explicit retraction of the prior item; nothing live remains.
Incident resolved and out of scope; the reinstated check-in is a scheduling action, though arguably nothing changes.
Ask for time across two days; no dissatisfaction, just a preference for talking.
Hedge, not a retraction: probably not real still leaves a live report, like the not-sure-if-a-bug case.
Intermittent price mismatch plus a buried diagnostic question; a person must handle both.
Explicit cancellation of today's call; act and notify.
Negation only blocks replying for them; the live ask is what may be said about launch timing.
Receipt shows the wrong total; a display defect, not a billing matter between us.
Small shift of an existing call; reversible and unambiguous.
Asks how fast something can happen; a timing answer is a commitment Max must not make.
Repeated auth prompt is a live defect; the word password appears but no credential does, so no PII.
Explicit yes plus a request for times; send the link.
The 404s are stale bookmarks, not a fault; the live ask is a link they already have access to.
Hedged discrepancy report is still live; Max cannot rule it expected.
Delegated but the meeting is ours with Dana; cancel and notify.
Self-retraction of a prior report; nothing live to act on.
Confidence-in-the-work escalation asking for a readiness judgment on a launch date; every part is a person's call.
Reschedule plus an availability question, both parts of the same shift.
Pleasantry and repair of tone: react, do not compose a reply.
Mobile usability defect on the card field; a field name is not a card number, so no PII.
